elements.content: Grammar focus: Conditional Inversion in Economic Forecasting.

Core Rule: Deploy inverted conditionals in economic forecasting: Had + S + V3 for historical counterfactuals, Were + S + to + Base for hypothetical forward-looking scenarios.

Counterfactual Analysis — Had + S + V3...: Had central banks intervened earlier, hyperinflation would have been averted.
Forward Projection — Were + S + to + Base...: Were tariff rates to rise by 5%, consumer spending would contract.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly forms a forward economic projection?
options: Were interest rates to drop, housing demand would surge.
Were interest rates drop, housing demand will surge.

elements.content: 2. What auxiliary opens a historical economic counterfactual?
Read and listen: three examples in context.

Were energy prices to spike (, GDP growth would decelerate.)
Had fiscal stimulus been withheld (, unemployment would have soared.)
